elaine.h: Quick question — for the upcoming access review, are we doing a full entitlement dump or a sampled/least-priv approach? I want to avoid a month-long churn if we can get good coverage via sampling.

sam.k: I'd vote for sampling + targeted fulls. Sample 10% of admin entitlements per org, and full scans for service accounts and keys older than 180d. fewer false positives and faster remediation. :+1:

jia.liu: Agree. Also need clarity on KMS audit capture: do our current exports include KMS key use events (encrypt/decrypt) for both GCP and AWS KMS? I recall some gaps in CloudAudit export last quarter.

mike_r: We had a gap — projects without audit-log sinks missed KMS Admin events. Short checklist: ensure audit export to GCS/BigQuery, enable DATA_READ/ADMIN for Cloud KMS logs; for AWS ensure CloudTrail includes management events and that KMS events aren't filtered out.

elaine.h: Good call. For the sampling heuristics: sample 10% of human admin groups each run, always include: superadmins, billing-admins, and any group with >5 changes in last 90d. For service accounts: include all with keys older than 180d or with >30k API calls last 90d. Does that sound reasonable?

sam.k: Yep. Add: if a service account has no owner tag, treat as high priority. Also add a check for long-lived personal tokens in secrets manager.

jia.liu: About KMS specifics — quick commands to verify key activity:
```
# GCP example
gcloud logging read "resource.type=project AND protoPayload.methodName:('Encrypt' 'Decrypt') AND resource.labels.project_id=YOUR_PROJECT" --limit 50

# AWS example
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --max-results 50
```
These helped us find missing sinks last time.

mike_r: Action item: I've opened SEC-298 to track "access review: sampling + KMS audit coverage". sec-bot created the issue: https://redwoodjira/internal/SEC-298 :robot_face:

elaine.h: I'll run a one-off sampling this week and post results in the ticket. Plan: export admin-group lists from Okta, map to GCP/AWS IAM principals, and run our scripts to capture last-active times. ETA EOD Friday.

sam.k: I'll update the runbook with the sampling thresholds and a remediation playbook for owners (email template + PR template for entitlement prune).

jia.liu: I'll validate the KMS audit exports and add a verification step to infra-onboarding to prevent future gaps. If I find projects with missing sinks I'll add them to SEC-298.

mike_r: Small note: for on-prem HSM/CMEK we don't have CloudAudit — add a manual check to the runbook to confirm HSM operator logs are being retained.

elaine.h: Decision recap: monthly sampled admin checks (10%), full service-account & key audits for >180d, require owner tag or escalate, and verify KMS audit exports across clouds. Owners: elaine (sampling run), sam (runbook + notifications), jia (KMS audit check), mike (HSM verification).

sam.k: Can we add export retention to the decision? Recommend 1 year raw logs in GCS + 3 years aggregated in BigQuery.

jia.liu: Agreed. I'll add retention policy suggestions to SEC-298.

elaine.h: Thanks team. I'll drop the sampling CSV into the ticket and ping owners individually for remediation. :wave: 

sec-bot: Reminder: SEC-298 assigned -> elaine.h, sam.k, jia.liu. Due: 1797640000.

mike_r: Nice. If anyone wants the helper script I used for last sweep ping me, I can share it and a lightweight linter that flags missing owner tags.

elaine.h: Please. That'll speed remediation.

sam.k: I'll prepare the email template and a short internal FAQ for owners re: what to do when they get a prune request.

jia.liu: One follow-up — do we want to include third-party integrations (Okta SCIM apps, CI/CD bots) in the same cadence or handle separately?

mike_r: Treat SCIM-linked apps as service accounts for now. They get full audit each run.

elaine.h: OK closing here. I'll post progress in SEC-298 and update this thread with any blockers.
